Subject: Request: current SOC 2 Type II and timeline for procurement review

Hi Sean,

We're starting procurement review for the vendor onboarding at VentureHealth. Our security team flagged that the copy of Redwood's SOC 2 Type II on file is labeled 'Redwood_SOC2_2024_TypeII.pdf' and appears to be out of date for our needs. Could you please:  

- Share the latest SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) or a secure download link
- Confirm the audit period covered by the most recent report
- Provide a bridge letter or interim attestation if there is a gap between reports

Procurement would like to complete review within two weeks if we can get evidence and an official letter on company letterhead. If any of this needs to go to legal or your compliance team, please point me to the right contact.

Thanks,
Erin Walsh
Sr. Procurement Manager
VentureHealth

Hi Erin — thanks for the note and sorry for the confusion. Short answer: we did have a reissued SOC 2 Type II earlier this year and the file name changed, which is likely why your copy looks stale. I’ve attached the current artifacts and summarized below.

Attachments included:  
- RDW_SOC2_TypeII_2025-v3.pdf (official reissued Type II report)
- RDW_bridge_letter_2026-03.pdf (bridge / supplemental attestation)

Quick summary:  
- Official report ID on our side: RDW-SOC2-2025-01.
- Audit period covered in combination (report + bridge): 2023-10-01 through 2025-08-31.
- The reissued PDF filename includes a v3 suffix; I can provide a signed cover letter on letterhead if procurement needs it.

If procurement requires a packaged evidence bundle or completion of a SIG questionnaire, Marissa (cc’d) can confirm timing. Expect: 1–3 business days for a signed cover letter + bridge; 3–7 business days for an expanded evidence bundle depending on scope.

If you need a secure download link instead of attachments, let me know and I’ll share a pre-authenticated Drive link.

Next steps suggested:  
1) Confirm whether the combined audit period (2023-10-01 — 2025-08-31) satisfies VentureHealth requirements.
2) If yes, indicate whether you need a signed cover letter and I'll route to Marissa.
3) If you have a questionnaire (SIG/CAIQ), send it over and we’ll queue it.

Happy to jump on a 20–30 minute call if helpful.

—Sean

Thanks Sean — appreciate the quick response and attachments. A couple of clarifying questions before we loop legal:  

1) The PDF you sent (RDW_SOC2_TypeII_2025-v3.pdf) has a header that reads an audit period of 2023-10-01 to 2024-09-30 (that matches the 2024 filename we have). Can you confirm where the 2025 end date comes from? Are you saying the bridge letter extends the assertion through 2025?

2) For our procurement checklist we require one of the following: (a) a single consolidated Type II that explicitly covers the most recent 12 months, or (b) a Type II plus a dated bridge/attestation that fills any subsequent period. If you have a single-file consolidated attestation on letterhead we would prefer that.

If you can confirm those two items (and include a signed letter on company letterhead confirming the combined coverage), we can proceed with legal review.

Best,
Erin
